lines.zh: 我悄无声息地滑过雪面。
lines.en: I glide over the snow without a sound.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀宽，扇起来很慢。
lines.en: My wings are broad and beat slowly.
I fly low over the snow.

lines.zh: 我从一棵枯树飞到另一棵。
lines.en: I go from one bare tree to the next.
I rarely walk. I fly.
The edges of my feathers are soft.

lines.zh: 我一转弯，雪就扬起一点。
lines.en: Turning lifts a puff of snow.
I land on a branch without a sound.
I slip from the treetop to the ground.
I beat my wings twice, slowly.
I fly along the snowfield's edge.
I hover briefly, low.
My shadow on the snow is faint.
I flap backward a little.
I sweep over the snow slope.
I don't make a sound, and neither does my flight.

lines.zh: 我绕着那块石头飞了一圈。
lines.en: I circle that rock once.
I perch on a bare branch, still.
The snowfield is white. I stand out.
I tilt my head and look under the snow.
My eyes are very yellow.
I don't call; it would scare things off.

lines.zh: 我的头能转很大的角度。
lines.en: My head turns very far.
The wind stirs my feathers.
Still as a snowdrift.
On a snowy branch I blink, slow.
This is the first time I've seen you.
The snow keeps falling. I don't mind.

lines.zh: 闭上眼，又睁开，雪还在下。
lines.en: Eyes closed, then open — still snowing.
Little to eat on this snowfield.
I smooth my feathers.
The night is long. I wait.

lines.zh: 雪地再白，我也看得见你。
lines.en: White snow or not, I see you.
You have no white feathers.
Keep that hand down for now.
I'm this still. You didn't notice me.

lines.zh: 我就在这棵树上看着你。
lines.en: I am on this tree, watching you.
Look left; I'm on the right.
I lift a wing.

lines.zh: 你抬头时，我的脑袋已经转到背后。
lines.en: By the time you look up, my head is already turned your way.

lines.zh: 我的白羽在雪里看不出来。
lines.en: My white feathers vanish in the snow.
My tail feathers have splayed.
These wings can still fly.
I stare at you, slowly.
I will remember this scent of blood.

lines.zh: 雪羽炸开，我发出一声短促的嘶叫。
lines.en: My feathers flare and a short screech escapes me.

lines.zh: 痛感顺着翼骨窜上来，我歪了下头。
lines.en: Pain shoots along my wing bones, and I tilt my head.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，把伤口藏进白羽里。
lines.en: I crouch low and hide the wound under white down.
What's that thing in your hand?
That isn't to my taste.
You hold it up; I don't move.
That's too still.

lines.zh: 把你的手从我的枝头拿开。
lines.en: Take your hand off my branch.
I prefer what's under the snow.
Try setting it on the ground.
I look, then leave.
That's less interesting than snow.
My wings open a little.
You touch me and I fly off.
Your hand throws up snow.
I skim past your shoulder.

lines.zh: 白羽贴着雪，一挪就没了影。
lines.en: White feathers against white snow — one shift and I'm gone.

lines.zh: 我落在雪上，几乎没有重量。
lines.en: I land on snow with almost no weight.
The impact made no sound.

lines.zh: 别撞我，这一身雪羽会乱。
lines.en: Mind my feathers — you've ruffled them.

lines.zh: 我无声滑开，只留下一阵冷风。
lines.en: I slide aside without a sound, leaving only cold air.
Another is on the snowfield too.

lines.zh: 雪鸮的翅，隔着一段落下来。
lines.en: An owl's wings settle a distance away.
It's whiter than I am.
We circle together, low.
We speak only with our eyes.
It spreads its wings first.
No trace remains on the snow.
Next time, perhaps the same ground.
I pin it with my talons.
This pearl is bright.
It turns in my talons.
This means nothing to me.
My eyes are too bright at night.
I can't fly far with it.

lines.zh: 我抓起它，像叼住一只旅鼠。
lines.en: I snatch it up the way I'd take a lemming.

lines.zh: 爪子一扣，这点重量不算什么。
lines.en: One grip of my talons, and its weight means nothing.
Movement under the snow.
I press low against the branch, wings tucked.
I've seen it. Precisely.
I don't call; I come down.
You're blocking my angle.
My wings are already folded.

lines.zh: 那双黄眼睛已经把你圈进去了。
lines.en: Those yellow eyes have already closed around you.

lines.zh: 我锁定你不需要声音，翅膀就是刀。
lines.en: I need no sound to mark you — my wings are the blade.
It's gone into the snow.
I perch and wait.
It pokes out again.

lines.zh: 我的头几乎转到了背后。
lines.en: My head turns nearly backwards.
It can't leave this snowfield.

lines.zh: 雪把它藏起来，也把它露出来。
lines.en: The snow hides it and reveals it.
I needn't hurry.
It froze, and so did I.

lines.zh: 我的爪子落下，一点声都没有。
lines.en: My talons strike without a sound.
My talons have caught.

lines.zh: 你甩开我，掉了两根羽毛。
lines.en: You throw me off; two feathers fall.
I rake your shoulder from above.
One bite, and not a feather comes loose.
You retreat; I climb again.
Light, and precise.
I came from behind you.

lines.zh: 我一抓，你手里的东西就掉了。
lines.en: One grab and your hand is empty.
I descend over the snowfield.

lines.zh: 我落在枯枝上，没有声音。
lines.en: I land on a bare branch, silently.
The snow hasn't stopped.
The white here is clean.
I fold my wings and look around.

lines.zh: 我先听清了雪落的声音。
lines.en: First I catch the sound of falling snow.
My shadow lies on the snow.

lines.zh: 雪地太亮，我的白羽反而不显眼。
lines.en: Snow is bright; my white feathers blend.
I tilt my head down at you from the branch.
There's little cover here.
Fire catches my feathers.

lines.zh: 落地时我扇了两下才停。
lines.en: I beat my wings twice before stopping.

lines.zh: 羽毛湿透了，我飞不起来。
lines.en: My feathers are soaked; I can't fly.

lines.zh: 爆响把我震得翻了个身。
lines.en: The blast flips me over.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿破了我的翅膀。
lines.en: An arrow tears my wing.
Light wraps me and I can't see.
The flash makes the snow glare.
I fall, and my wings do nothing.
